title: Injectra: Retrofitting Extensibility into Web-Based Desktop Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.20713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can generate code based on natural language prompts, opening up new possibilities for users to customize software and extend its functionality. This paper proposes and implements Injectra, a general-purpose code injection and feature enhancement system for existing desktop clients, suitable for applications whose user interfaces are built using embedded browser engines (such as Electron) or system WebViews (such as Tauri). Injectra decouples the host integration logic from the upper-layer enhancement code. Combining both runtime integration and pre-launch bootstrap mechanisms, it injects JavaScript, HTML, and CSS into the application's internal Web runtime environment through a unified execution channel, thereby enabling modifications to interface rendering, adjustments to interactive behaviors, and client-side functionality extensions. translated_title: Injectra：为基于Web的桌面应用程序改造可扩展性
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型能够根据自然语言提示生成代码，为用户定制软件和扩展其功能开辟了新的可能性。本文提出并实现了Injectra，这是一个面向现有桌面客户端的通用代码注入与功能增强系统，适用于使用嵌入式浏览器引擎（如Electron）或系统WebView（如Tauri）构建用户界面的应用程序。Injectra将宿主集成逻辑与上层增强代码解耦，结合运行时集成与预启动引导两种机制，通过统一的执行通道将JavaScript、HTML和CSS注入到应用程序的内部Web运行时环境中，从而实现对界面渲染的修改、交互行为的调整以及客户端功能的扩展。该系统使用命令行界面（CLI）作为统一入口，允许……
tldr: Injectra是一个通用的代码注入与功能增强系统，通过统一执行通道将JavaScript、HTML和CSS注入到基于Web技术（如Electron、Tauri）构建的桌面应用内部运行时环境中，实现对现有桌面客户端的界面修改、行为调整和功能扩展。
en_tdlr: Injectra is a general-purpose code injection and feature enhancement system that injects JavaScript, HTML, and CSS into the internal web runtime of web-based desktop applications (e.g., Electron, Tauri) through a unified execution channel, enabling interface modifications, behavior adjustments, and functionality extensions for existing desktop clients.
